intro: Work through 3 steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline 23:30 the same day. Type your essay directly into the box on the website. AI will comment right after you submit, and the teacher will also read and comment. Sunday is the P1 class (17:00 to 19:00): warm up for 15 minutes only, no submission.

steps.title: Step 1 · Writing Part 1: making orange juice
steps.instructions: Notes: 1 oranges picked from the trees by hand · 2 oranges washed · 3 oranges squeezed by a machine · 4 juice filtered to remove the seeds · 5 juice poured into bottles · 6 bottles delivered to shops by truck. Describe the process in 150 words, with an introduction and an overview, using the present simple passive and sequencing words. Do not copy the notes. Write for 20 minutes as in a real test, then spend 10 minutes self-correcting with this checklist: (1) rewrite the task in your own words in the introduction · (2) the overview states the number of steps, the first step and the last step · (3) sequencing words First, Next, After that, Finally · (4) present simple passive verbs · (5) describe the equipment, e.g. a squeezing machine · (6) check -ed spelling and is / are. Each item earns 1 point. Type your essay in the box below (about 150 words), then press Submit at the bottom of the page.

open.model: Mẫu thầy gợi ý: Introduction: "The notes show how orange juice is made." Overview: "There are six stages, from picking the oranges to delivering the bottles to shops." Thầy chấm bài và ước lượng TA, CC, LR, GRA cho từng bài.

ai.type: IELTS Writing Task 1 (process), bài luyện tập ngắn
ai.task: The notes show the process of making orange juice. Describe the process. Notes: 1 oranges picked from the trees by hand; 2 oranges washed; 3 oranges squeezed by a machine; 4 juice filtered to remove the seeds; 5 juice poured into bottles; 6 bottles delivered to shops by truck. Yêu cầu: introduction viết lại đề bằng lời của em, overview nêu số bước, bước đầu và bước cuối, dùng thể bị động hiện tại đơn và từ nối trình tự, không chép nguyên ghi chú.
criteria: introduction: viết lại đề bằng lời của mình
overview: nêu số bước, bước đầu và cuối
từ nối trình tự: First, Next, After that, Finally
động từ bị động hiện tại đơn (is / are + V3)
mô tả thiết bị, ví dụ a squeezing machine
chính tả đuôi -ed và is / are

steps.title: Step 2 · Reading preview
steps.instructions: Read the passage once, then choose True, False or Not Given. Underline the words in the passage that show the answer.
context: Many students delay their work even when an exam is close. Psychologists say the reason is not laziness but stress: a difficult task makes people feel anxious, so they choose something easier, such as checking their phone. A study of 300 university students found that those who made a daily plan the night before started their homework earlier than those who did not. Another finding was that students who worked in short blocks of 25 minutes, with a five-minute break, felt less tired. However, the study did not show whether the plan or the short blocks improved exam results.

items.q: Psychologists believe laziness is the main reason students delay work.
A difficult task can make people feel anxious.
items.explain: "a difficult task makes people feel anxious".

items.q: The study included students from several countries.
items.explain: Bài chỉ nói 300 university students, không nói quốc gia.

items.q: Students who planned the night before started their homework earlier.
The study proved that short blocks improve exam results.

steps.title: Step 3 · Voice note
steps.instructions: Read aloud the introduction and overview you just wrote. Pronounce the -ed endings clearly. Record 1 voice note.
lines: Đọc phần introduction và overview của chính em.
steps.note: Thầy sẽ nghe và nhận xét âm cuối -ed của em.

send_today: Hoàn thành các bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 3 sẽ được gửi tự động cho thầy khi bấm Nộp bài.
